WRITE-SET AND PROHIBITED EDITS (execution-000002, execution-000013). `git diff --name-only 4b16c57...3c8ba5d` lists exactly the 42 tracked paths of plan section 3 and nothing else: schemas.py, all thirteen generate_catalogue.py, all thirteen station_products.parquet, the twelve named test files, and ADR 0012 + ADR 0014. No native.parquet, no tests/test_data/*, no CONTEXT.md, no ADR 0015, no pyproject.toml, no uv.lock, no .pce/repository-contract.json, no tests/typecheck/* (verified by an explicit pathspec-scoped `git diff --stat`, which was empty). Version is 0.1.49 at both base and head. `git rev-list --count` is exactly 1; the full commit message is exactly 'refactor: rename published record bounds' with no footer or co-author line. `git tag --points-at HEAD` is empty. pr-body.md exists at the worktree root and `git ls-files --error-unmatch pr-body.md` errors, proving it is untracked; its bytes match the section-9 text exactly. Grepping the diff for new noqa / type: ignore / pytest.mark.skip / xfail returned nothing. `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no` is empty; I left the worktree tracked-clean.

OLD NAMES (execution-000002). `git grep -n -E '"start_date"|"end_date"' 3c8ba5d -- schemas.py providers/*/generate_catalogue.py tests` returns twelve hits and I inspected each: USGS SERIES_ONLY_FIELDS and its index lookup (generate_catalogue.py:132, 826), tests/test_data/usgs_nwis_metadata_series.json x4, the USGS SERIES_ONLY_FIELDS mirror and malformed-native test (test_usgs_nwis_generate_catalogue.py:54, 665), and the four deliberate bare-name-absence assertions. BINARY REWRITE IS VALUE-PRESERVING (execution-000004). For each of the thirteen artifacts I read the base blob and the head blob out of git and compared them: every head frame has the exact eight-column tuple in the new order, the plan's exact row count (180 / 52145 / 16114 / 738 / 4155 / 33139 / 4092 / 194 / 44001 / 3903 / 1650 / 157548 / 8715), pl.Date on both bounds at positions 6 and 7, and `polars.testing.assert_frame_equal(after.rename(inverse), before, check_exact=True)` passes for all thirteen. Nothing but the two column names changed. Output ended 'ALL_PRESERVED'.

GATES (execution-000006, execution-000007). `uv run pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q` exits 0 with '1622 passed, 2 skipped in 397.79s' — the plan's stated baseline, with the only skips the pre-existing folium imports. `uv run ruff format --check` exits 0 ('162 files already formatted', so no formatting drift is hidden by the in-place format gate), `uv run ruff check` (no --fix) exits 0, and `uv run ty check src` exits 0.

EVERY CHECK MUTATION-TESTED (all mutations in /tmp/scratch, never in the worktree; scratch deleted afterwards). Acceptance baseline on the unmutated built artifact: 34 passed (execution-000008). (1) Renaming the two columns back to start_date/end_date in ch_foen's artifact makes test_all_packaged_catalogues_expose_exact_reduced_carriers fail with CorruptCatalogArtifactError 'missing required columns: published_record_start_date, published_record_end_date' (execution-000009). (2) Reverting schemas.py to the bare names makes both test_catalogue_schema_objects_define_expected_columns and test_catalogue_schema_objects_define_polars_dtypes fail (execution-000010). (3) Making the USGS generator emit None for both bounds makes test_station_product_matching_covers_absent_unique_duplicate_agreeing_blank_and_conflicting_series fail on the 2001-01-02 / 2025-03-04 pair, proving the USGS dates are genuinely asserted through the new keys (execution-000011). (4) Nulling published_record_end_date in the USGS artifact fails both the new non-null-count assertion in test_package and the positional USGS content pin (execution-000012). (5) Truncating lt_lhmt from 194 to 193 rows fails test_package at the height assertion, line 155 (execution-000014). No check was vacuous and no assertion was deleted, loosened, skipped, or xfailed: the only expected-value changes in the diff are the seven content digest pins the plan authors verbatim, and the suite proves each of them against the rewritten artifacts.

CLAIM HONESTY. pr-body.md makes three claims. 'rename canonical station-product record bounds' is the schemas.py diff. 'update all thirteen generators and value-preservingly rename all thirteen packaged station-product artifacts' is confirmed by execution-000002 (thirteen generator diffs) and execution-000004 (thirteen exact frame equalities). 'align schema regression coverage, affected content pins, and current ADR terminology' is confirmed by the seven changed pins, the two new bare-name assertions plus the strengthened test_package block, and the two one-line ADR substitutions. Its Validation list names the six section-7 gate commands; I re-ran the four non-mutating ones myself and all are green. No claim exceeds the diff.

This gate's own probes were mutation-tested rather than merely asserted: each rejection probe above is paired with the execution-000008 acceptance run on the same built artifact, differing only in the mutated property. The delivered work adds no lint/type/test configuration rule, so there is no rule-activating configuration entry to delete.
